reason: Reviewed 2026-11-18: no patched release; official npm latest is 4.0.7 and https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-fc5q-39xc-vjpf lists all versions <=4.0.7 as affected with no fix. Every installed picomatch node is dev-only (Tailwind 3 -> chokidar/micromatch; Vite 6 -> tinyglobby/fdir; Vitest 4), matching repository-controlled file/config globs. npm ls picomatch --omit=dev is empty, app source does not import it, and production serves the built dist. The repeated-extglob ReDoS requires an attacker-controlled glob pattern, which is not a runtime input here. Recheck upstream and remove this temporary exception when a patched release is available.
